board: DS1822+ bare chip in 3-pin TO-92 (Maxim/Analog Devices), pins GND, DQ, VDD
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring with an auto-added 4.7 kOhm DQ pull-up, design checks, breadboard, simulator test at -12.25 C, PCB DRC, TO-92_Inline footprint). It uses family 22h and the 12-bit 0.0625 C two's-complement register from the datasheet, read with MicroPython's built-in ds18x20 module, so no custom driver is needed.
breakoutPinoutSource: DS1822 datasheet (Maxim 042815) Table 1 and TO-92 bottom-view pin assignment: pin 1 GND, pin 2 DQ, pin 3 VDD (archived at http://web.archive.org/web/2020id_/https://datasheets.maximintegrated.com/en/ds/DS1822.pdf)
